Ledger.title: Immutable Ledger
Ledger.description: The chronological source of truth. Every transaction, sub-division, and goal contribution is recorded here securely.
Ledger.emptyDesc: Your immutable ledger will begin tracking the moment you initialize an account balance or log a revenue stream.

Goals.title: Wealth Goals
Goals.description: Partition your liquid savings into concrete physical milestones. Withdrawals pull natively from your master Savings account.
Goals.emptyDesc: Lock away liquid capital from your main Savings pillar into dedicated physical financial milestones.
Goals.newDesc: Establish a new sanctuary milestone to conquer.

Governance.title: Governance
Governance.description: Dictate the underlying operational rules for your sanctuary. Adjust automated allocation ratios and behavioral alerts.
Governance.allocDesc: Define the master ratios for your incoming finances. Every time you log revenue, it will be fractionalized instantly across these 4 pillars according to your governance structure.
Governance.prefDesc: Silence the internal engine or stay absolutely informed. Modify how your sanctuary alerts you to important events.
Governance.subsDesc: Manage your connection to Mizani platform features.
Governance.proDesc: You have limitless access to the unified ledger engine, unlimited category thresholds, and automated recurring logic.
Governance.freeDesc: You are bounded by 50 manual expense deductions per month. Upgrade to lift the boundary.

Onboarding.step1Subtitle: Set your financial pillars. Every income will automatically flow according to these ratios.
Onboarding.step2Subtitle: Declare the balances currently in your possession to seed the ledger.
Onboarding.initializationError: A disruption occurred in the sanctuary initialization.
Onboarding.completionMessage: The framework for your wealth is complete. Click below to immortalize your ledger.

Expense.title: Log Deduction
Expense.description: Record a withdrawal from your expenses pillar.

Income.title: Log Revenue
Income.description: Define the source and amount. The Sanctuary will automatically mathematically fracture it according to your blueprint.
Income.allocationNote: Percentages can be permanently altered in Governance.
